where_to_look: Only 5 estimates on a $9.4bn company - unusually thin for the cap, and the single best structural argument for room here. Establish the actual buy-side ARR bar, since PATH reactions are set by ARR and net-new ARR, not the $0.04 EPS line

Net new ARR and dollar-based net retention: PATH's last several reactions have hinged on whether NRR stabilised above the 110s. That is a disclosed number with no public proxy, so look for the pre-print sell-side revisions and the CFO's prior-quarter qualitative guide

Agentic automation monetisation: whether 'Agentic Automation'/Autopilot has moved into disclosed ARR contribution or is still pipeline language. The competitive read-across is Microsoft Copilot Studio and ServiceNow's agentic disclosures in their own June-August prints
US federal and public-sector exposure - PATH has a meaningful government book and FY27 Q2 spans the US federal fiscal-year-end run-up. Federal procurement award data for the window is public
Share count and the buyback: PATH has been retiring stock while SBC stays high, and the net dilution trajectory is a disclosed, unglamorous line that moves per-share numbers
